What to do right now

You are one signed form away. Leave this tab, open your email, and finish it on this device.

1

Open your email

Go to the inbox you just entered. The form is already on its way — it does not come back to this page.

2

Find Dropbox Sign

Look for a message from Dropbox Sign. Older mail may still say HelloSign — same company, same form. Check Spam, Junk, and Promotions if it is not in Primary.

3

Fill it out and submit

Open the link, complete every field, and submit. That is the step that actually starts your membership — Buy Membership only sent the form.

4

Watch for our confirmation

As soon as you submit, you can expect a confirmation from the club shortly after.

After you submit

As soon as you fill it out and submit, expect a confirmation shortly after. That email is your confirmation you are becoming a member of the fastest-growing health and family-oriented spot in the South Bay.

Don't see the email yet?

Give it a couple of minutes. Then look in the places filters hide it.

  • Search your inbox for Dropbox Sign or HelloSign.
  • Check Spam, Junk, and Gmail's Promotions tab.
  • Still nothing? Call us at (310) 530-0630 or email info@southendclub.com — we will resend it.
